tasks.CalculateTotalCost: Calculate the total cost of trousers and shirts based on given prices.
tasks.DetermineRatio: Calculate the ratio of trousers to shirts when the maximum number of trousers is purchased.
tasks.FormulateEquation: Formulate an equation representing the relationship between the number of trousers and shirts purchased.
tasks.SolveForMaxTrousers: Solve for the maximum number of trousers that can be bought with the given budget.
